html.noScript: Please enable JavaScript to visit this little world.
home.title: Happy Birthday, {recipient}!
home.story: I meant to give you a cyber cake, but I forgot to finish it. Don't worry - I gathered all the ingredients. Some of them might be a little... unprocessed. Come to my farm and make a birthday cake of your own! - {sender}
home.empty: A place for your birthday cake.
home.complete: Your cake has a place at the table.
home.tableLabel: A real three-dimensional wooden birthday table
game.title: A little world to make your own
game.note: Explore, gather and make something sweet.
game.sceneLabel: First-person three-dimensional scene; use the mouse pointer to select visible objects
table.selected: A table, waiting for something sweet.
settings.title: Settings
settings.resetNote: Your items and progress will be cleared. Your language and volume settings will be kept.
settings.resetDone: Progress reset. Your preferences were kept.
status.ready: Progress is saved on this browser.
status.migrated: An earlier save is readable. Its format will be upgraded on your next saved change.
status.unknown: Saved progress is unavailable. Existing data has been kept.
error.lock-unavailable: This browser cannot safely coordinate saving between pages. Saved progress can be viewed, but changes are disabled.
error.storage-unavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. Existing progress has not been replaced.
error.future-save: This save was made by a newer version. It has been kept unchanged; please use a compatible version.
error.unsupported-content: This save needs a different content version. Its data has been kept unchanged.
error.unsupported-save: This save format is not supported. Its data has been kept unchanged.
error.corrupt-save: Saved progress could not be read. Its original data has been kept; saving is paused.
error.checksum-mismatch: The saved data failed its integrity check. It has been kept unchanged; saving is paused.
error.invalid-save: Saved progress contains unsupported data. It has been kept unchanged.
error.migration-failed: The earlier save could not be upgraded safely. Its original data has been kept unchanged.
error.write-failed: Your change could not be saved. Previous saved progress has not been replaced. Read it again before retrying.
error.stale-session: Progress was reset or replaced in another page. Read the current saved progress before making another change.
error.session-restored: This page was restored while a change was waiting. Read the current progress before trying again.
error.confirmation-stale: Progress changed or this page was restored. Choose Reset progress again to review a new confirmation.
error.lock-busy: Another page is saving. Please try again in a moment.
error.generic: This action could not be completed safely. Existing saved progress has been kept.
error.resource: The original Minecraft resources could not be loaded. Please reload the page.
error.webgl: This browser could not start WebGL2. A real three-dimensional scene is required.
error.contextLost: The graphics connection was interrupted. Your saved progress is safe.
error.contextRestored: The three-dimensional scene is ready again.
